### porousPoiseuille3d

These examples simulate Poiseuille flows through porous media.
The implementation reproduces the benchmark *Example A* by Guo and Zhao [@guo2002lattice].
The theoretical maximum velocity is calculated as in [@guo2002lattice, Equation (21)], and the velocity profile as in [@guo2002lattice, Equation (23)].
